name: Rapid Critical Metals Limited
summary: Established in 2021 and based in Sydney, Australia, Rapid Critical Metals Limited is an exploration and evaluation firm focused on mineral resources. The company, which rebranded from Rapid Lithium Limited in May 2025, operates internationally with a primary emphasis on Africa and the United States, seeking to uncover nickel and copper deposits. A significant holding is its fully owned Nyanga Magmatic nickel-copper project in Southern Gabon, which encompasses two exploration licenses covering an estimated 2,725 square kilometers. Furthermore, the company has an agreement in place to acquire an 80% stake in the Bend Nickel Project, an approximately 12-square-kilometer site located in Zimbabwe.
